name: RB efficiency suite: RYOE/att + missed tackles forced/att + explosive run rate (@StephenKrupka)
census_status: HOMED — the suite as one record (the three components are published together and read together); RYOE's underlying expectation model is NGS-family, recorded INTERNAL-ONLY per Garrett's standing rule where the credit applies
stamp_required: rushing attempts + yards over expected + missed tackles forced, season-to-date as of capture
stamp_gap: only the catalog's published instances are held; no standing in-house suite is computed
probe_finding: Definition (deep-scroll catalog, 2026-10-15): @StephenKrupka's RB efficiency suite plots three per-attempt measures together — RYOE/att (rushing yards over expected per attempt), MTF/att (missed tackles forced per attempt), and explosive run rate (share of carries reaching the explosive threshold). Stamped instance (through Week 3, as published): Keaton Mitchell RYOE/att +0.54 vs Omarion Hampton -0.50 — the suite's point is the CONTRAST: expectation-adjusted production, elusiveness, and explosiveness as three separate questions about the same back, not one blended grade. Role in-engine: the RB-side efficiency read, read next to C-288/C-286's opportunity side (% of team designed runs x target share) — opportunity says what a back is given, this suite says what he does with it beyond the blocking.
kin: C-286 Krupka chart franchises (RB opportunity series — the opportunity half)
